surface_mechanism_description: The formation of the Hf silicate layer at the interfacial region and its transformation into silicide layers during annealing at 700 °C under ultrahigh vacuum conditions.
evidence: The formation of the Hf uSi bonding appears when the film is annealed at the temperature of 700 °C for 5 min in UHV as shown in Fig. 3. Hf uSi bonding appearing at 14.3 eV corresponds to hafnium silicide caused by the bond between Hf and Si. In this process, we can also detect other intermediate bonding states with higher binding energy than that of hafnium silicide as the O bonded to Hf and Si in the silicate film is dissociated into the vacuum.
